title: The cloud run-event feed writes only dispatched/collected/run_finished — no run_held, no wall_clock_fired
body: The tick pins ONE schema and vocabulary, and the cloud writer emits only three of the local reconciler's stages. A cloud run that holds an attempt for a person, or whose worker's wall clock fires, produces no line a laptop's `watch` or `status --follow` can act on — the exact information gap a gate run restart (u9h) is most likely to create. Widening run-feed.ts to the reconciler's held/wall-clock stages is a small, contained follow-up in the same checkpointed steps.
